remarks: Impressive 4 BEDROOM, 4.5 BATH home on a cul-de-sac in desirable Clarence neighborhood! This home was built in 2002 and is a staggering 4,210sf of living space (not including the potential additional space in the basement).  Hardwood floors welcome you into the 2-story Foyer. You will love the space and layout of this large home - including Formal Living and Dining Rooms with tray ceilings, classic decorative pillars and mouldings; convenient dedicated Home Office/Den; oversized 2 story Family Room with impressive floor to ceiling windows and gas fireplace; a heated Sunroom is off the Family Room (perfect for plants, meditation or hobby room). All of this is on the main floor plus the half bath and oversized Kitchen with island, butler's pantry (with wet bar), walk-in pantry and Morning Room leading out to the back deck! Going up the double-sided staircase, you will immediately notice how open the 2nd floor is, with good separation between bedrooms and a hallway overlooking the Family Room. At the top of the stairs are 2 bedrooms that both have deep closets and share a Jack and Jill full bathroom. The 3rd bedroom is perfect for a guest room - it is at the end of the hall and has its own private full bath. The Primary Suite is simply stunning - large double doors open to a massive bedroom complete with 2 walk-in closets, a separate room (ideal for getting ready but also can be used as a sitting room, bonus personal office area or a perfect place for your Peloton!) The Primary Bath has 2 counters/sinks for space, soaking tub and separate standing shower, along with convenient privacy toilet room. The basement is another ~2,000sf of space that has previously been used as additional living space with an egress window, full bathroom plus 2 separate storage rooms and a 3rd room for utilities.  Outside is just as impressive with a large deck overlooking the inground pool and the rear lot line filled with trees and Ransom Creek.  Additional "must have" features are first floor laundry, attached 2.5 car garage, central air, sprinkler system and more upgrades throughout.
